scope: Private actual GPU max-cu-squared kernel, actual protected class acoustic helper, actual DtVariable and two separately owned first-step rejection processes. No project source edits or completed physical steps.
cli: upl_gpu_k0_time_r1.exe --time Scale|FirstCurrent|FirstRequested <ordinary -gpu args with frozen k0 512-node input and a distinct fresh output>

input.input_preparation: Root-owned preparer copies retained BI4 byte-exact and changes only runtime XML HydraulicConductivity from 0.0001 to 0. All other XML values and geometry remain unchanged; hash binding is required before any component process.
input.geometry: Retained 32x16 2D axis-XZ periodic lattice, no GenCase or initial physical-field rewrite by this fixture.
input.source_identity: The root-owned fresh authoritative GPU source/program/runtime freeze must bind the four time-policy source changes before helper compile/run. This author note does not attribute an executable to a build.

checks: empty/no-native behavior returns zero with invalid=np
nextafter solid-volume boundary accepted when representable n remains positive
DBL_MAX J rejected because n rounds to one
input arrays and output tail unchanged

references.production_operand_max: cu2=(K+4G/3+Kw/n)/(rhow+(rho0-rhow)/J), exact bit maximum required with the same promoted float material operands
references.independent_inertia: rhos=(rho0-n0*rhow)/(1-n0), rho=(1-n)*rhos+n*rhow; max cu2 must agree within 64*DBL_EPSILON*max(1,abs(reference))
references.standalone_parameter_scope: Scalar inputs are valid actual material. Parameter-negative tests are real host initialization-hook calls, not claims that the standalone kernel validates all scalar parameters.

Scale_mode.legacy_rho_test: Actual helper bound remains bit-exact after all positive legacy velrhop.w values are changed; no physical force/integrator is invoked on that poisoned state.
Scale_mode.ghost_test: Periodic J values are poisoned with NaN while all native J remain valid; actual helper bound must remain bit-exact.
Scale_mode.request_contract: Exactly-at-bound FixedDt/current accepted; nextafter-above current, FixedDt and DtMin rejected. FixedDt receives the full bound, independently checked by its signed error=fixed-bound. No clipping or DtMin uplift, and physical arrays/PRE unchanged.
Scale_mode.init_hook_scope: The 18 negatives mutate initialized host configuration only, invoke the actual InitPorosityObserverGpu and restore all changed scalars/flags after catch. These are not fresh XML-parser negative tests. Material/step Infinity, NaN, missing periodicity, floating particles and nonzero conductivity are explicitly covered.

first_step_modes.FirstCurrent: locked current=1s, fixed requested=2^-24; actual predictor force must finish then current guard reject before any PRE allocation/update
first_step_modes.FirstRequested: locked current=2^-24, fixed requested=1s; actual predictor force must finish then requested guard reject before any PRE allocation/update
first_step_modes.nonempty_force_evidence: All 512 native pore rates overwrite the sentinel; max absolute native theta>1e-5 and max absolute pore rate>1Pa/s. Actual Arg/Ace/Rsigma allocations and finite stage maxima are required.
first_step_modes.clock: actual TimeStep=0 and Nstep=0 before and after rejection; no pressure/J corrector or completed step implied

execution_gates: Root reads all new author inputs
Fresh authoritative GPU build plus retained OFF/observer controls are reviewed first
Compile helper against the exact frozen authoritative objects/runtime
Run each Debug mode under actual memcheck and require zero errors/leaks
Run corresponding Release modes only after Debug passed
Use distinct fresh outputs; never rerun a completed mode or overwrite failed evidence
limits: Necessary local acoustic/force scales are not sufficient spectral or nonlinear stability proof
k=0 only: no Darcy, diffusion or gradient-k limit
2D no-wall axis periodic only; no gravity/load/drainage/moving boundaries
No public GPU option, formal release, restart or physical accuracy acceptance
No full physical integration in this component; actual free-run coarse/half remains a later gate
Existing later 5Pa/.005mm bounds are not changed or replaced by these component checks
